title: Rename reserve_stock to allocate_stock
description: Exported function rename in inventory.py breaks fulfillment.py and upstream routes.
diff:
diff --git a/app/services/inventory.py b/app/services/inventory.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app/services/inventory.py
+++ b/app/services/inventory.py
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ from app.db import OrderRepository
 from app.db.models import OrderRecord
 
 
-def reserve_stock(order_id: str, sku: str) -> bool:
+def allocate_stock(order_id: str, sku: str) -> bool:
     repo = OrderRepository()
     repo.save_order(OrderRecord(order_id=order_id, sku=sku))
     return True
